name: Antique Teacup
desc: Every chip and ding in this cup has a story. Maybe one day it will tell them to you.

name: Ash
desc: The remains of all that has burned. And from ashes we return.

name: Azurite
desc: A deep blue copper mineral. Somewhat delicate, keep away from air and moisture.

name: Branch Dead
desc: A brittle, decayed branch abandoned on the ground, slowly returning to the earth. Does not summon enemies.

name: Candy Cane
desc: A bright red-and-white piece of candy that carries the scent of winter cheer.

name: Coal Hard
desc: A refined version of coal. Its glossy black surface radiates the light around you.

name: Coconut Oil
desc: Good for your skin and in drinks! Do you like pina coladas?

name: Coral Stone
desc: Layers and layers of calcium carbonate build upon each other to form these branch-like coral structures.

name: Essence of Chaos
desc: An unstable essence that defies all order, warping gear through unpredictable outcomes. Consumes all remaining potential to trigger a chaotic transformation.

name: Essence of Destruction
desc: A volatile essence that tears apart a fragment of power, reshaping it into something new. Re-rolls the type of a selected substat.

name: Essence of Flow
desc: A fluid essence that reshapes and refines, guiding power into a new form. Re-rolls the value of a selected substat.

name: Essence of Growth
desc: A living essence that takes root within gear, giving rise to new potential. Adds a new random substat.

name: Essence of Rebirth
desc: A radiant essence that unravels and renews, forging a completely new beginning. Locks a selected substat and re-rolls all other substats.

name: Fishbone
desc: What's the story, fishbone? What waters were you swimming in?

name: Flax
desc: A soft plant that can be used to create linen and other fabrics.

name: Foxtail
desc: Meadow cat's-tail is a great source of fiber for livestock or pets.

name: Fur
desc: A soft patch of fur, warm enough to explain why something else wanted to keep it.

name: Gold Ore
desc: Unprocessed, raw gold. You could be rich! Imagine the vast fortune waiting to be mined! Or let's just give it to the craftsman to make a trinket or two.

name: Gravion Chunk
desc: A solid chunk of Gravion that feels sturdy, but is clearly unworked.

name: Gravion Crystal
desc: A flawless block of Gravion that shimmers like a diamond. Famed for its unmatched defense.

name: Gravion Shard
desc: Fragments of a material used to reinforce armor. Feels more like coal than metal.

name: Ingot Gold
desc: A solid block of gold. Valuable for its use in currency, and for the finest of jewelry.

name: Ingot Iron
desc: A block of iron ready to be forged into the tool or weapon of your choosing.

name: Larva
desc: The juvenile stage of many insects. Soon it'll become something bigger and scarier.

name: Leaf
desc: Just an ordinary green leaf, fallen from one of many trees in this labyrinth.

name: Lunaris Chunk
desc: A smooth chunk of Lunaris that shimmers with quiet magic.

name: Lunaris Crystal
desc: A pristine Lunaris crystal that radiates celestial energy. Famed for its otherworldly powers.

name: Lunaris Shard
desc: Fragments of a material used to reinforce artifacts. Glows faintly in the darkness.

name: Marble
desc: A smooth stone with elegant veins, often used where plain rock would be rude.

name: Memory Fragment
desc: Faint remnants of monsters, lingering within magical items.

name: Moonrock
desc: A strange glowing rock that some say came from the moon.

name: Moonstone
desc: This softly glowing rock is highly desired by the craftsman. It's like holding a piece of moonlight.

name: Mushroom
desc: Its thick cap absorbs blows while its damp body holds steady near the water.

name: Obsidian
desc: Naturally occurring volcanic glass. While sharp, it is also brittle, not very practical for weapon use.

name: Oceanite
desc: This stone carries the aroma of the ocean with it. If you stare deeply, the swirling blue-green patterns look just like waves.

name: Pipe
desc: A hollow length of pipe, scratched from use and sturdy enough for repairs.

name: Pouch Fairy Dust
desc: Prepackaged and imported from the Fae Court, less potent than dust straight from the source.

name: Resonance Core
desc: A fractured core that anchors the unstable echoes surrounding the Spire.

name: Silica Sand
desc: A very fine sand great for industrial use.

name: Spider Web
desc: An intricate pattern spun from webbing. Typically used to trap and catch prey. The beautiful silk may one day be used to make thread.

name: Tree Bark
desc: Smells like pine! No, wait... oak? Maybe willow?

name: Tree Sap
desc: The natural juices secreted from trees and plants carry nutrients throughout the plant.

name: Tungsten
desc: A strong and dense metal with a very high melting point. Great for high-temperature applications.

name: Vulkanite Chunk
desc: A raw piece of Vulkanite that burns with latent power.

name: Vulkanite Crystal
desc: A perfectly formed Vulkanite crystal that burns everything it touches. Famed for its offensive capabilities.

name: Vulkanite Shard
desc: Fragments of a material used to reinforce weapons. The jagged splinters are warm to the touch.
